title: 龙国篇 第四十章 人皇传承一龙国篇 第三十九章 团聚
content_zh:
随这世界局势的不断紧张，叶忠留在武神局的时间也不多了。
毕竟，战神关那两位威震八方的人皇已悄然离开，仅凭一位ss级武神的孤影镇守，无异于独木难支，实非上策。按常理而言，玄冰于龙国境内神秘现身，叶忠身为镇守战神关的城主，理应在那里镇守才对。然而，此刻的他，却悄然现身于武神国的腹地，这无疑昭示着，他的此行，是一场隐秘而深沉的行动。
具体是何等任务，想必也就只有国主与他的妻子才懂。
此刻，夕阳如血，余晖洒在武神局那座古老而庄严的高台上，将叶忠孤独的身影拉得修长而孤寂。他独自一人矗立在那里，目光穿越层层云雾，紧紧锁定在遥远的西北方向，风，从远方呼啸而来，带着一股不祥的气息，卷起了他额前几缕散乱的发丝，也似乎在诉说着即将到来的风暴。
叶忠深吸一口气，转身面向身旁的女子——丽莎，她的面容在夕阳的映照下显得格外柔和，但眼中却闪烁着坚毅的光芒。
他缓缓开口，声音低沉而有力：“如今，战神关的局势，就如同这即将落幕的夕阳，一秒比一秒黯淡，一日比一日紧张。我深感忧虑，那沉睡的异能兽，它们的力量在暗处悄然复苏，不出三年，定会再次席卷而来，到那时，仅凭冰儿与我，怕是难以力挽狂澜。”
丽莎闻言，眉头紧锁，眼中闪过一丝忧虑。她知道，叶忠所言非虚，那些曾经被封印的异能兽，其中就有十王，每一王都拥有毁天灭地的力量，一旦它们挣脱束缚，后果不堪设想。她轻声问道：“所以……您想？”
叶忠：“没错，造神计划，必须再次启动。”他的语气坚定，仿佛已经做出了不可更改的决定。
丽莎闻言，脸色骤变，她几乎不敢相信自己的耳朵。“可阿恒才不过16岁！”她的声音中带着几分急切与不舍，阿恒，那个天真烂漫、对未来充满憧憬的少年，怎能成为这场赌博中的棋子？他的人生，本应是自由与快乐的，而不是被沉重的责任与危险所束缚。
叶忠理解丽莎的担忧，但他更清楚，时间不等人，形势逼人。
他轻轻拍了拍丽莎的肩膀，目光中满是深邃与坚定：“丽莎，我明白你的顾虑，但正如你所说，时间不等人。恒儿，他或许年轻，但他的潜力，是我们所有人都无法估量的。他是我的儿子，我相信他，他是我们最后的希望，也是人类未来的曙光。他的路，注定不平凡。这次，我会倾尽所有，哪怕赌上我这条老命，也要让他成为真正的神，守护这片土地，助他完成从小的那个梦想”
叶忠：“想当初为师培养你们，都认为你们就是我的骄傲，结果造神计划的失败，让你们辈子最多止步于人皇境巅峰，为师很是愧疚”
丽莎：“师父言重了，若无您那春风化雨般的教诲，我不过是一粒随风飘散的尘埃，哪有今日之我？其实，心中藏着愧疚的，应当是我。是我辜负了您的期望，将大好时光浪费在了闲逛与追星之上，日复一日地缺席课堂。倘若当年我能多一份专注，少一份浮躁，或许，阿凯的命运……也会有所不同”
此刻，叶忠心凝视着满怀愧疚的丽莎，心中涌动的苦楚犹如潮水般翻涌，百转千回。
忆往昔，他们三人组成的铁三角，是何等的风华正茂，意气昂扬，而今，却已是物是人非，生死相隔，各奔东西，唯有丽莎孤影孑然。
叶忠轻轻拍了拍丽莎的肩膀，声音里满是沉痛与自责：“小凌的离去，作为师父，我心之痛，又何尝亚于你分毫？回想当年，我若执意阻拦你们涉足那凶险莫测的任务，或许，小凌便能免于那场不幸”
“当年，为师也有苦中，将恒儿与云儿放在武神殿就匆匆忙忙赶去‘天火战场’，然而命运总是弄人，即便我拼尽全力，以最快的速度穿梭于密林与荒漠之间，却依然无法改写这一段历史，龙兄......”
此刻，当初那一幕再次浮现叶忠脑海。
异能兽是不属于这个世界的生物，它们来自另一个位面的强大生物，它们的到来，如同天际划过的流星，既璀璨又带着毁灭的气息，预示着一个新时代的开启。自异能兽跨越位面的壁垒，降临到这个星球，已足足有三百余载。这漫长的岁月里，人类与异能兽之间的战争从未停歇，每一场战斗都是对生存意志的极限考验。
在这漫长的对抗史中，人们逐渐意识到，异能兽之中存在着一种超乎想象的强大存在——异能王。

它们并非普通的异能兽，而是经过无数岁月苦修，修为达到了令人仰望的境界。
从最初的兽形，历经万载岁月，蜕变成拥有智慧与人形的存在，这一过程不仅是对力量的极致追求，更是对生命本质的深刻领悟。因此，异能王在异能兽族群中享有至高无上的声望，它们各自统治着一方领地，成为了当地族群中无可争议的第一强者。
然而，故事的复杂程度远超想象。异能兽族群并非单一而统一，它们内部同样存在着纷繁复杂的势力划分，随着时间的推移，十位异能王在不同的地域崛起，它们各自拥有独特的异能与不可一世的威严，彼此间既相互竞争又暗自结盟，共同维持着异能兽世界的微妙平衡。
这十位异能王，每一位都是一部活生生的传奇，它们的名字在异能兽的世界里如雷贯耳，让无数异能兽心生敬畏，也让人类世界陷入了前所未有的危机之中。
在这危机四伏的时代，人类并未坐以待毙。他们中涌现出了一批又一批的勇士，他们或是拥有特殊能力的异能者，或是精通古老武术的战士，他们肩并肩，心连心，誓要守护这片土地免受异能兽的侵袭。
而在这场跨越种族与位面的较量中，最引人瞩目的莫过于人类与异能王之间的对决。每一次交锋，都是智慧与力量的碰撞，是光明与黑暗的较量，每一次胜利，都凝聚着无数人的汗水与牺牲，也点燃了人类心中不灭的希望之火。
然而，谁又会知道，当十位异能王聚集之时，代表的这个世界的“终结”，天火战场一战，十王聚集，天地色变，空间撕裂，人类为了延续种族，也因此付出了惨痛代价。
武神国一位人皇，科导国俩位技王，和铸剑国俩位剑灵天皇，与魔法国一位法王。
“师父！”丽莎看着满眼沧桑的叶忠，心中更是五味杂陈。
content_en:
As the situation in the world continues to become tense, Ye Zhong's time to stay in the Martial God Bureau is running out.
After all, the two mighty Human Emperors in the God of War Pass have quietly left. Just relying on the lone figure of an SS-level Martial God to guard them is tantamount to being alone and not the best option. According to common sense, Xuan Bing appeared mysteriously in the Dragon Kingdom. As the city lord guarding the War God Pass, Ye Zhong should be guarding there. However, at this moment, he quietly appeared in the hinterland of Martial God Kingdom, which undoubtedly showed that his trip was a secret and profound operation.
What the specific task is, presumably only the king and his wife know.
At this moment, the sunset is like blood, and the afterglow shines on the ancient and solemn high platform of the Martial Arts Bureau, making Ye Zhong's lonely figure long and lonely. He stood there alone, looking through the layers of clouds and mist, firmly fixed on the far northwest direction. The wind roared from the distance, carrying an ominous breath, and rolled up a few stray strands of hair in front of his forehead, which seemed to be telling the coming storm.
Ye Zhong took a deep breath and turned to face the woman beside him, Lisa. Her face looked particularly soft under the sunset, but her eyes shone with perseverance.
He spoke slowly, his voice low and powerful: "Today, the situation at the God of War Pass is just like the sunset that is about to end. It is getting dimmer and dimmer every second, and it is getting more and more tense day by day. I am deeply worried. The power of those sleeping supernatural beasts is quietly resurrecting in the dark. In less than three years, they will be swept away again. By then, Bing'er and I alone may not be able to turn the tide."
Lisa frowned when she heard this, and a trace of worry flashed in her eyes. She knew that what Ye Zhong said was true. Among the supernatural beasts that had been sealed, there were ten kings. Each king had the power to destroy the world. Once they broke free from their restraints, the consequences would be disastrous. She asked softly: "So...what do you want?"
Ye Zhong: "Yes, the god-making plan must be started again." His tone was firm, as if he had made an unchangeable decision.
When Lisa heard this, her face changed suddenly, and she could hardly believe her ears. "But Ah Heng is only 16 years old!" There was a bit of eagerness and reluctance in her voice. How could Ah Heng, that innocent young man full of longing for the future, become a pawn in this gamble? His life should have been one of freedom and happiness, rather than being bound by heavy responsibilities and dangers.
Ye Zhong understands Lisa's worries, but he knows better that time waits for no one and the situation is pressing.
He gently patted Lisa on the shoulder, his eyes full of depth and determination: "Lisa, I understand your concerns, but as you said, time waits for no one. Heng'er, he may be young, but his potential is immeasurable to all of us. He is my son, and I Believe in him, he is our last hope and the dawn of the future of mankind. His path is destined to be extraordinary. This time, I will give everything, even if I risk my life, to make him a true god, protect this land, and help him fulfill his childhood dream."
Ye Zhong: "I thought you were my pride when I trained you as my teacher. However, the failure of the god-making plan has made you stay at the peak of the Human Emperor Realm at most in your lifetime. I feel very guilty as a teacher."
Lisa: "Master's words are serious. Without your spring breeze and rain-like teachings, I would be just a speck of dust drifting in the wind. How could I be who I am today? In fact, I should be the one who hides guilt in my heart. It was me who failed to live up to your expectations. I wasted my good time on wandering and chasing stars, and was absent from class day after day. If I could have been more focused and less impetuous back then, perhaps Akai's fate... would have been different."
At this moment, Ye Zhongxin stared at Lisa who was full of guilt, and the pain in his heart surged like a tide, turning over and over again.
Recalling the past, the iron triangle formed by the three of them was so prosperous and high-spirited. Now,But things have changed, life and death are separated, everyone has gone their separate ways, only Lisa is alone.
Ye Zhong patted Lisa's shoulder gently, his voice full of sorrow and self-blame: "As a master, my heart aches for Xiao Ling's departure, no less than yours. Looking back on those days, if I had insisted on preventing you from getting involved in that dangerous and unpredictable mission, maybe Xiao Ling could have avoided that misfortune."
"Back then, I had a hard time being a teacher. I left Heng'er and Yun'er in the Martial Temple and hurried to the 'Sky Fire Battlefield'. However, fate always plays tricks on people. Even if I try my best and travel between the dense forest and the desert at the fastest speed, I still can't rewrite this period of history. Brother Long..."
At this moment, the original scene came to Ye Zhong's mind again.
Aberrant beasts are creatures that do not belong to this world. They are powerful creatures from another plane. Their arrival is like meteors crossing the sky, both bright and destructive, heralding the beginning of a new era. It has been more than three hundred years since the supernatural beast crossed the barrier of the plane and came to this planet. In these long years, the war between humans and supernatural beasts has never stopped. Every battle is an ultimate test of the will to survive.
In this long history of confrontation, people gradually realized that there was an unimaginably powerful existence among the supernatural beasts-the Ability King.
They are not ordinary supernatural beasts, but after countless years of hard work, their cultivation has reached a level that is enviable.
From the original animal form, after thousands of years, it transformed into a being with wisdom and human form. This process is not only the ultimate pursuit of power, but also a profound understanding of the essence of life. Therefore, the Ability King enjoys supreme prestige among the Ability Beast clan. They each rule a territory and become the undisputed strongest among the local clans.
However, the story is more complex than imagined. The tribe of supernatural beasts is not single and unified. There are also complex divisions of forces within them. As time goes by, ten kings of psychic beasts have risen in different regions. They each have unique powers and unparalleled majesty. They compete with each other and secretly form alliances with each other to maintain the delicate balance of the world of supernatural beasts.
Each of these ten superpower kings is a living legend. Their names are like thunder in the world of superpower beasts, instilling awe in the hearts of countless superpower beasts and putting the human world into an unprecedented crisis.
In this crisis-ridden era, mankind is not sitting still. Groups of warriors emerged among them. They were either supernatural beings with special abilities or warriors proficient in ancient martial arts. They stood side by side, heart to heart, and vowed to protect this land from the invasion of supernatural beasts.
In this contest that spans races and planes, the most eye-catching one is the showdown between humans and superpowers. Every confrontation is a collision of wisdom and strength, a contest between light and darkness. Every victory embodies the sweat and sacrifice of countless people, and also ignites the eternal fire of hope in human hearts.
However, who would have known that when the ten superpower kings gathered, it represented the "end" of the world. In the Battle of Skyfire Battlefield, the ten kings gathered, the color of the world changed, and the space was torn apart. Humanity paid a heavy price in order to continue the race.
There is one human emperor in the Martial God Kingdom, two technical kings in the Kedao Kingdom, two sword spirit emperors in the Sword Making Kingdom, and one Dharma King in the Magic Kingdom.
"Master!" Lisa looked at Ye Zhong, whose eyes were full of vicissitudes of life, with mixed feelings in her heart.
